description: The full catalogue record for one document: collection, entity, dates, page count, SHA-256, extraction status and the URL of the original at its source. Use to check a document's provenance or details. It holds no document text; get_document_text and fetch return that.

lf_id.description: Archive id from a search result, LF- followed by 12 characters, e.g. LF-6e02fd648a12.

name: get_document
title: Get a record's catalogue entry
